notes.title: New version 1.2.0.0, already supports Japanese and Korean!
notes.notes:
Today, the latest version 1.2.0.0 has been updated, including the addition of "Japanese" and "Korean" and language support. Currently, the game supports four languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1995760/_/

notes.title: Dream Magic Will Now Supports MacOS Platform
notes.notes:
Although the game has been released for a long time, I still have not given up. Now the game supports the MacOS platform, and players with Apple systems can also play it!

In addition, Windows and Mac archives support cloud synchronization and sharing!

notes.title: 2023-1-17 version 1.1.2.0 update
notes.notes:
1. Increase 2x acceleration function
2. Add anti-theft version detection (non steam platform will not be able to start the game)
3. The price of the game will be permanently reduced by $1 ($4.99 to $3.99)
